title: When Does an Early Warning Signal Deserve Action?
excerpt: Convert one early customer signal into a precommitted intervention rule with a baseline, persistence test, owner, verification step, and reset condition.
primary_goal: Help CS leaders decide which early customer signal merits intervention before an aggregate health score changes.
primary_cta: Build one Intervention Trigger Ledger entry for a recurring customer risk.
playbook_description: A signal definition, baseline, trigger rule, verification step, response owner, reset condition, and review record for acting before an aggregate health score changes.
